_comment: Paste the 'wearable' block into your Claude Desktop config under mcpServers. Restart Claude Desktop after editing. Mock-by-default; set WEARABLE_BACKEND_URL to point at a real consented-store proxy when one ships, and WEARABLE_MOCK_PROFILE=rest|heat to flip the canned data scenario.

env._WEARABLE_BACKEND_URL_HINT: leave unset to use the in-memory mock; set when a consented-store proxy is available
